extra.message: User-supplied `username` query parameter is interpolated directly into an SQL SELECT statement passed to `run_sql_query()`. An attacker can inject arbitrary SQL (e.g., UNION-based extraction or boolean/time-based blind injection).

All fields of the `User` Pydantic model (`name`, `username`, `password`, `address`, `email`, `contact`) are interpolated into an INSERT SQL statement and executed via `run_sql_query()`. Allows SQL injection through any user-controlled field.
User-supplied `username` query parameter is interpolated directly into a DELETE SQL statement. Allows SQL injection and arbitrary deletion of user records.
User-supplied `user.address` from the request body is interpolated directly into a DELETE SQL statement without quoting. Allows SQL injection and arbitrary deletion of user records.

Raw JSON from `request.json()` is passed directly to `get_nosql_users()`, which forwards it to `users.find(query)`. Attackers can send NoSQL operators such as `{"$ne": null}` to bypass filtering and retrieve all records.
